draft_en.subject: The SWP-series port layouts on a Marvell platform - XVI label
draft_en.body:
Hello XVI team,

Over the past months you had a few product mails from us - most recently "24 Port PoE Managed Switch" on 26 August 2026 - and there was no reason to answer a mass mail. This one is specific.

For the SWP-series PoE switches under the XVI label (SWP1508 / SWP1016M / SWP1024), we can supply the same port layouts under your label with a choice of housings from small lots: the 8-PoE slot as 8 x Gigabit PoE+ + 2 x SFP, L2+ managed, Marvell-based - model STC-28DGGPM - $87.4 USD EXW with your logo (MOQ 1, 15-day validity); the 16-PoE managed slot as 16 x Gigabit PoE+ + 2 x SFP L2 managed - STC-2216GPM - $153.5; the 24-PoE slot as STC-424DGGPM-280W - $145.7. CE/RoHS files supplied; EAC stays on your side.

One question: which SWP model do you reorder most often, so we quote its equivalent first?

Best regards,
Simon
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
